descriptions.zh:
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### Queries per second (QPS) limit  
The QPS limit for this API is 10 queries per second per User. If the limit is exceeded, Rate Limiting will be applied to your API Calls, which may Impact your business. Please invoke the API appropriately.
